payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all subrectangles using 2D prefix sums to query viola counts in O(1), pruning with early break when count reaches k.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all possible top-left corners and sizes, uses prefix sums for O(1) range queries, and breaks early when a subrectangle meets the threshold, making it a complete search with pruning. No bit manipulation is used.
